gloss: enka singer; a singer who performs enka (traditional Japanese popular ballads)

definitions.gloss: enka singer; a singer who performs enka (traditional Japanese popular ballads)
definitions.explanation: Refers to professional singers who specialize in the enka genre.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{演歌歌手|えんかかしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to a concert by a famous enka singer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}、{演歌歌手|えんかかしゅ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたかった→なる：01970_naru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: My grandmother says she wanted to become an enka singer when she was young.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{演歌歌手|えんかかしゅ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{紅白歌合戦|こうはくうたがっせん}→紅白歌合戦：29111_kouhakuutagassen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{出場|しゅつじょう}している→出場する：20348_shutsujousuru⟧。
examples.english: That enka singer appears on the Kouhaku singing contest every year.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{演歌|えんか}→演歌：07082_enka⟧ (enka, a genre of sentimental Japanese ballad music) and ⟦{歌手|かしゅ}→歌手：00197_kashu⟧ (singer). Enka is associated with themes of love, loss, loneliness, and nostalgia, often using a distinctive vocal style called kobushi (melismatic vibrato).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {演歌歌手|えんかかしゅ}⟦デビュー→デビュー：11016_debyuu⟧: debut as an enka singer
- {大物|おおもの}{演歌歌手|えんかかしゅ}: big-name enka singer
- {演歌歌手|えんかかしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧: to aspire to become an enka singer

CULTURAL NOTE:
Enka singers are often associated with an older audience demographic, though some younger performers have revitalized the genre. Many famous enka singers are household names in Japan and regularly appear on NHK's annual ⟦{紅白歌合戦|こうはくうたがっせん}→紅白歌合戦：29111_kouhakuutagassen⟧. The genre peaked in popularity during the 1970s-80s but remains culturally significant.
